about.title:
Hi, I'm Marilyn
— and I get it.
about.p1: I'm a mom, nutrition and fitness professional, and a woman who knows what it feels like to lose yourself while taking care of everyone else.
about.p2: I earned my Bachelor's degree in Nutrition in Mexico, where I began helping women through fitness bootcamps. I quickly realized that so many women wanted to feel stronger and healthier, but simply didn't know where to start.
about.p3: After moving to the United States and becoming a mom, my own journey changed. Somewhere between motherhood, responsibilities, and building a new life, I stopped prioritizing myself.
about.quote: "That season became a turning point for me."
about.p4: Today, I combine my education, experience, and personal journey to help other women do the same — because taking care of everyone you love shouldn't mean forgetting to take care of yourself.

features.title:
Everything you need
to flourish
features.subtitle: Not just workouts — a complete system designed to help you feel strong, confident, and consistent.
features.f1_text: Beginner-friendly to advanced programming. Build real strength and see your body transform week by week.
features.f2_text: Real food, real results. Evidence-based nutrition coaching to fuel your workouts and your life — without fad diets.
features.f3_text: You're never alone. A sisterhood of women cheering you on, celebrating wins, and showing up for each other every day.
features.f4_text: Real-time coaching with Marilyn. Ask questions, get corrections, and feel the energy of training together live.
features.f5_text: Unlimited classes with flexible timing. Train at a time that works for your busy life as a mom, professional, and human being.
features.f6_text: No cookie-cutter plans. Marilyn meets you where you are and guides you toward where you want to be — step by step.

faq.title:
Got
questions?
faq.subtitle: We've got answers. If you don't see what you're looking for, reach out directly!
faq.q1: Do I need experience to join?
faq.a1: Absolutely not! MillyFit is designed for women at all fitness levels. Whether you've never set foot in a gym or you're getting back after a break, Marilyn will meet you exactly where you are and guide you forward safely.
faq.q2: What's the difference between the plans?
faq.a2: The 2-Week Intro is exclusively for new clients who want to experience MillyFit without commitment. The MillyFit Membership gives you full ongoing access to all classes, nutrition guidance, live sessions, and community. The Drop-In is perfect for occasional visitors who want flexibility.
faq.a3: MillyFit offers both in-person classes in Jacksonville, FL and online access. Reach out directly to learn about current class schedules, locations, and online options that fit your lifestyle.
faq.q4: How does the nutrition coaching work?
faq.a4: Marilyn's nutrition coaching is practical and sustainable — no extreme diets, no counting every calorie. You'll get guidance on how to eat to fuel your training, manage energy levels, and enjoy food without guilt. It's about building long-term healthy habits.
faq.q5: Can I cancel my membership at any time?
faq.a5: Yes. The MillyFit Membership is flexible. You can cancel at any time without penalties. We believe in building a community where you stay because you love it — not because you're locked in.
faq.a6: Simply choose the plan that's right for you above and complete your registration. New clients — we highly recommend starting with the 2-Week Unlimited Classes to experience MillyFit fully before committing to a membership.
